answer: A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 19 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a mesa bet on surviving 79 epochs of grading, and every meadow settlement recomputes the harbor schedule, so an hostile operator who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 79 epochs rather than arriving at once. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
